purpose: Score natural-language user queries without converting ordinary entity recognition into avoidable clarification.

rules.common_entity_default: Resolve a well-known issuer to its common primary listing unless the query names a conflicting market or code.
rules.multi_market: When multiple market interpretations are equally reasonable, retain each complete source-coherent answer as an accepted variant.
rules.needs_clarification: Use only when no concrete entity/time/meaning can be resolved without a material assumption.
rules.historical_month_k: Month-K takes precedence. Query dates locate the containing natural month; Oracle discloses resolved full-month window.
rules.financial: Success cases request 1-6 directly reported fields from the same issuer, report, statement, period, consolidation scope, currency, and unit family. No cross-statement combination, complete statement, comparison, ratio, growth, calculation, or inference.
